# Tithify

> Free, lightweight, and open-source native Windows desktop widget (C++ Win32) that displays the real-time Nepali (Bikram Sambat — वि.सं.) date and offline calendar directly above the taskbar with ~0.01% CPU usage and <5MB RAM.

Tithify is an ultra-lightweight desktop calendar and date utility for Windows 11 and Windows 10. It converts Gregorian (AD) dates to Bikram Sambat (BS) completely offline (1975–2100 BS), shows official Nepal public holidays, and requires zero background runtime dependencies.

## Key Resources
- [Official Website](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/): Official home page, feature walkthrough, live preview, and web calendar details.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/aayushlbef/Tithify): Source code, issue tracker, and development discussions.
- [Latest Releases & Downloads](https://github.com/aayushlbef/Tithify/releases/latest): Standalone installer (Setup.exe) and portable zip releases.
- [One-Line PowerShell Installer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aayushlbef/Tithify/main/install.ps1): Automated non-admin silent installation script for Windows terminal.
- [Sitemap](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of the official website.

## Technical Specifications
- [Platform & OS Requirements](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#install): Native 64-bit support for Windows 11 and Windows 10.
- [Architecture & Rendering](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#features): Pure C++ with Win32 API and GDI+ rendering (no Electron, no Node.js, no WebView runtime).
- [Resource Footprint](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#efficiency): Ultra-efficient resource consumption with <5MB RAM footprint and ~0.01% CPU at idle.
- [Offline Engine](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#features): 100% offline Bikram Sambat conversion covering years 1975 to 2100 BS.
- [License](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0): Open source licensed under the Apache-2.0 License.

## Features & Capabilities
- [Taskbar Date Widget](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#preview): Live Bikram Sambat date floating above the Windows taskbar with customizable layout and position locking.
- [Interactive BS Calendar](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#preview): Full interactive calendar with month navigation, dual BS/AD date display, and keyboard navigation.
- [Nepal Public Holidays & Festivals](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#features): Highlights Saturdays, government public holidays, and festivals (Dashain, Tihar, Chhath, etc.) with local caching.
- [Theme Auto-Adaptation](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#features): Dynamically detects Windows Light and Dark modes via WM_SETTINGCHANGE and switches colors seamlessly.
- [Full-Screen Auto-Hide](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#features): Automatically hides when running games or movies full-screen to avoid distractions.

## Alternative Comparisons
- [Tithify vs. Web & Electron Calendar Apps](https://tithify.guptaaayush.com.np/#efficiency): Comparison showing Tithify's <5MB RAM and ~0.01% CPU usage compared to 150MB+ RAM in web and Electron wrappers.
